_doc: Criteria for a 600 m block to count as a suitable analysis window (used by run_stack.py --candidates/--auto-points and by the notebook button 'Find candidate windows'). Edit the numbers, keep the keys. Land-cover fractions in percent of the block (ESA WorldCover 2021), slopes from the Copernicus DEM 30 m sampled every 90 m.
_notes: Ranking: suitable blocks sorted by the columns in rank_by (ascending). n_best stars are shown, at least min_separation_km apart. SilverSword (Hawaii, slope 13 deg) would NOT pass with max_slope_mean_deg = 5 although it gave the clearest moisture response so far; raise it to 10-15 if you want hillside grassland included.
